# ManageMyWeb (https://www.managemyweb.co)

> ManageMyWeb turns normal Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom online stores into fast, walkable 3D shops that open right inside Chrome or Safari—with zero app download. We also manage monthly cloud hosting, DNS, email setup, speed fixes, backups, and same-day store edits over WhatsApp.

## What We Do
- **Custom 3D Online Stores**: Walkable 3D stores where shoppers spin products 360° on shelves, pick sizes or options, read brand stories beside products, and pay in one tap via Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay, or Stripe.
- **Keep Shopify or WooCommerce Intact**: Your inventory, pricing, payment methods, and orders stay completely unchanged inside your existing store dashboard.
- **Monthly Website Care**: Fast cloud hosting (< 1.1s load time), domain & DNS care, SSL certificates, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email setup, daily backups, and same-day store edits via WhatsApp.
- **Try Free Before Paying**: Send your website link and get a free working 3D preview made with your own products in 48 hours before receiving a custom quote.
